sourceHeader.time: 1 Reaction, which you take when an allied creature within range takes damage

system.description:
You transform into a wave of water that resembles a demon-like fish, and act as a barrier between your ally and the triggering effect. You move up to your speed, and end your movement within 5 feet of your ally. You then gain 2d8 + 8 temporary hit points, and interpose the damage the ally would take.

Hydrofication. This jutsu gains the Clash keyword and if you reduce the incoming damage to 0, then if the triggering creature is within 10 feet of you, then they take 2d8 + 8 cold damage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the temporary hit points you gain and damage you deal with your Hydrofication effect by +1d8. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you grow in size and can interpose for all allied creatures in a 15-foot cube.
